title: Guardian's Discourse
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji realized he might be the only variable capable of seeing through this cosmic chess game, the Guardian warned him: the price was one he could not bear.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji tried to sort out his thoughts, a familiar chill spread from the depths of his soul—that was the resonance from his fate's twin, like an awakening reflection in a mirror. In the chaotic sea of consciousness, an old and authoritative voice suddenly rang out: "You've finally arrived, successor of Chen Ji." Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, and the scene before him stole his breath—he was no longer in the secret chamber of Tianqing Sect, but instead standing in an endless Void, surrounded by flowing star rivers and shattered plane fragments, as if the entire universe had been compressed into this single space.

dialogue.content: "There's no need to panic. This is merely your consciousness projection." The old voice sounded again, carrying a timeless desolation. "I am the Guardian of the Tianji Record, and also an existence unknown to what you call the 'Eye of Heavenly Secrets.' Or perhaps I should say—I am a remnant soul sealed here by the true 'Chess Player.'" In the Void, a humanoid form condensed from pure light slowly emerged.

text.content: Chen Ji looked around. The Void composed of star rivers and plane fragments was heartbreakingly beautiful, yet everywhere was pervaded by an eerie stillness. He tried to mobilize the spiritual energy within his body, only to find his power was negligible in this space, like a single drop in the vast ocean. "Who is this 'true Chess Player' you speak of?" he asked in a low voice, his voice echoing in the Void without any echo. "In this universe, is there an existence higher than the Eye of Heavenly Secrets?" The Guardian's light trembled slightly, as if sighing silently.

dialogue.content: "The Eye of Heavenly Secrets?" A hint of mockery tinged the Guardian's voice. "It is merely a 'camera' that existence has set up in your universe. It thinks it controls the fate of the Three Realms, never knowing that above its head, countless 'Eyes of Heavenly Secrets' are monitoring countless 'Three Realms.'" The Guardian raised his hand, and a shocking scene suddenly materialized in the Void—countless spheres of light were scattered across the darkness like stars, each sphere containing a complete world, with endless civilizations rising and falling within them.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Those spheres of light, each was a complete world, each world had an Eye of Heavenly Secrets. They were like parasites, attached to their respective worlds, feeding on the fate of all beings. "This is..." His voice was hoarse. "Is this the truth beyond the Three Realms you speak of?" The Guardian nodded slowly: "These countless worlds are what you collectively call 'universe.' But in higher dimensions, it has a more precise name—the Chessboard."

dialogue.content: "Chessboard?" Chen Ji caught the deeper meaning in this word. "Are you saying we are all chess pieces?" The Guardian was silent for a moment, then said: "Not just you. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets is a chess piece, the Guardian is a chess piece, and even the 'Chess Player' who set all this in motion..." His voice suddenly dropped lower. "Perhaps is also merely a chess piece in the hands of a higher-dimensional player. All things have their masters, all beings have their shackles. True freedom belongs only to those who step outside the chessboard."

text.content: Chen Ji felt a wave of dizziness. His worldview collapsed at this moment—he once believed the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was the master of this universe, that defeating it would bring freedom. But now he understood that even defeating the Eye of Heavenly Secrets was merely overturning a single piece on the chessboard. The true game was far beyond his reach. "That 'Chess Player'..." He spoke with difficulty. "What does it want?" The Guardian stared directly into his eyes, his gaze profound as an abyss: "What it wants is transcendence. It wants to break through the barriers of dimensions and become the true 'One.'"

Chen Ji was silent. He recalled the moment he obtained the Tianji Record Fragment, remembered the Heavenly Fate Value consumed each time he used his foresight ability, remembered Mo Xiansheng's meaningful words "You are the chosen one." So none of this was coincidence—behind all the fortunes and coincidences, there was an invisible hand pushing. "The Tianji Record..." He murmured. "What is it? Is it also a chess piece of that Chess Player?" The Guardian's light dimmed slightly for an instant: "The Tianji Record is the only 'loophole' in this chessboard. It is the legacy left by a previous Transcender, and the only possibility to break the game."

"Loophole?" A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as his mind raced, connecting all the information. The reason the Tianji Record was fragmented might not be natural deterioration, but deliberate destruction by the Chess Player. Did that Transcender leave this treasure precisely to wait for someone with the potential to break the game? And had the Eye of Heavenly Secrets been searching for the Tianji Record's holder merely to "complete Heavenly Secrets"? Or was it executing the will of that Chess Player, trying to completely erase this loophole?

choice.prompt: The Guardian's words contained shocking secrets, and Chen Ji needed to make his first response amid the shock.

choices.description: Since the Tianji Record is the only loophole, then my existence is that of a chosen game-breaker. No matter what lies ahead, I must continue.
choices.visible_reward: May gain the Guardian's trust, possibly obtaining more information
choices.risk_hint: Is it too hasty to completely trust a stranger?

dialogue.content: "I understand." Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the shock and fear in his heart. "Since the Tianji Record is the only loophole, then I am the one chosen to fill it. Whether the path ahead is smooth or an abyss, I will walk it." His voice was calm and firm. "Please tell me more."

choices.description: Everything came too suddenly—a stranger suddenly revealing the truth of the universe—there must be something fishy. I need verification.
choices.visible_reward: Show the protagonist's caution and wisdom, not easily led astray
choices.risk_hint: If the Guardian is truly well-intentioned, questioning may cost important information; if harboring ill intentions, perhaps this will reveal its true colors.

dialogue.content: "What you say is indeed shocking." Chen Ji's gaze turned sharp. "But I have a question—you said the Tianji Record is a 'loophole,' a legacy of the Transcender. Why would that Transcender leave this thing behind? And how do you know all this?" A cold smile curled at the corner of his mouth. "In your story, I hear nothing about your own origins."

choices.description: Whatever the truth, the Guardian telling me all this must have its purpose. I need to know what it wants me to do.
choices.visible_reward: Strike at the heart of the matter, quickly obtain key information
choices.risk_hint: Exposing my focus too early may be exploited.

dialogue.content: "What you've told me is indeed a truth I never imagined." Chen Ji stared directly at the ball of light. "But what I want to know more is—why are you telling me all this? What do you want me to do?" His tone was calm yet carried unavoidable sharpness. "A sealed remnant soul, suddenly speaking the truth of the universe to a 'chess piece'—this in itself defies reason."

The Guardian was silent for a long while, the ball of light swaying gently in the Void, like a candle flickering in the wind. "You asked three choices." Its voice carried a hint of praise. "Those who accept everything will lose themselves; those who question authenticity will be trapped in fog; those who inquire about purpose..." It paused. "Are the ones truly qualified to inherit the Tianji Record." The light suddenly surged, illuminating the entire Void. "Because in the eyes of the Tianji Record's holder, there is no 'truth,' only 'benefit.' Not beguiled by truth, only caring about what one wants—this is the potential of a game-breaker."

text.content: Chen Ji remained unmoved, continuing to press: "So you still haven't answered my question." The Guardian let out a low laugh: "Good, very good. I'll tell you my purpose—I want freedom." A hint of bitterness permeated its light. "I have been sealed in this Void for who knows how many tens of thousands of years, like a walking corpse. I have helped countless Tianji Record holders, but they all failed—either erased by the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, or collapsed before the truth. And you, are the most promising person I've seen to break the game."

dialogue.content: "What can you give me?" Chen Ji was not moved by this rhetoric, but grew even more composed and questioning. The Guardian's light slightly dimmed: "I can give you three things. First, the complete memories of the Tianji Record Fragment, allowing you to see its former whole; second, the weakness of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, a secret it will never tell anyone; third—" Its voice suddenly dropped lower. "A chance to choose. In the final game, you may choose which side to stand on."

text.content: Chen Ji carefully digested the meaning of these words. The three things the Guardian could provide, each was enough to change the entire game's direction. But he also understood—greater fortune often comes with greater cost. "The final game... what does that mean?" he continued asking. The Guardian said: "When your Tianji Record is complete enough, when you have collected enough Heavenly Fate Value, when you truly see through the nature of this chessboard, you will face a choice—to become the new Chess Player, or to destroy the entire chessboard."

Chen Ji felt a shudder spread from his spine. Destroying the chessboard—what did that mean? The Three Realms he inhabited, or everything including those countless parallel worlds? "If I choose to destroy the chessboard..." He spoke with difficulty. "What happens to the beings in those worlds?" The Guardian's voice turned ice-cold: "You've finally reached the core question. Chess pieces on the board have no right to speak of a Chess Player's mercy." These words were like cold water poured over Chen Ji's head, shocking him awake—in this cosmic-level game, compassion might be the most luxurious thing.

choice.prompt: Faced with the Guardian's conditions and the truth of this cosmic chess game, Chen Ji must respond.

choices.description: Since I'm already in the game, avoidance is not an option. I will accept this power, but retain the right to make the final choice.
choices.visible_reward: Gain the Guardian's knowledge and power support
choices.risk_hint: Once accepted, there is no turning back.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji was silent for a moment, then spoke slowly: "I accept your power. But I have one condition—the final right to choose must remain with me. No matter how the situation develops, I will not become anyone's puppet." A hint of relief appeared in the Guardian's light: "Good, this is the attitude a game-breaker should have."

choices.memory_label: 与守护者达成初步协议

choices.description: Before making any promises, I need to know more details. What exactly is the weakness of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets you speak of?
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more key information, accumulate chips for the final choice
choices.risk_hint: The Guardian may grow impatient, or only reveal partial information.

dialogue.content: "I need more information." Chen Ji remained unmoved. "You said the Eye of Heavenly Secrets has a weakness—specifically what? Before I make my decision, I need to know what I will be facing." The Guardian let out a low laugh: "Indeed cautious... Fine, I'll tell you a secret. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' true body is not within your Three Realms. Its core lies hidden in the缝隙 between higher dimensions."

choices.description: This game is too vast—I refuse to be anyone's chess piece. No matter what you say, I will not participate.
choices.visible_cost: Lose important information and power support
choices.visible_reward: Maintain absolute autonomy,不被任何势力裹挟
choices.risk_hint: The Guardian may turn into an enemy, or withdraw all help.

dialogue.content: "I refuse." Chen Ji's voice was calm yet firm. "This game is too vast—I cannot bear it. Rather than shoulder the mission of saving the universe, I'd rather live out my days in these Three Realms." The Guardian's light suddenly dimmed: "Do you think you have a choice? There has never been a Tianji Record holder who walked away unscathed—"

text.content: The Guardian's words made Chen Ji's heart tighten. He knew the other spoke truth—among the Tianji Record holders, which one had a good end? Even if he refused now, the gears of fate would push him forward endlessly. But even so, he did not want to easily become anyone's chess piece. "I heard you." He said calmly. "But I still reserve the right to question." The Guardian's light reignited: "That is precisely why I admire you. You are different from them—you have ambition, yet no greed; you have resolve, yet no recklessness."

Just then, the star rivers in the Void began to violently tremble, countless plane fragments scattering like leaves in a storm. The Guardian's voice suddenly became urgent: "Time is running out—it has sensed our conversation." Chen Ji immediately realized—it was the Eye of Heavenly Secrets! Its tendrils in this universe had finally detected the anomaly. "Remember what I said." The Guardian's light began to fade. "You are the one chosen by the Tianji Record, you possess the only 'free will' in this chessboard. Don't waste it—"

Chen Ji felt a tremendous repelling force pushing him outward, his consciousness plummeting like falling into an abyss. The Guardian's final words echoed in his ears: "When you're ready, call my name with the Tianji Record—Guardian." The light completely dissipated, and darkness devoured everything. Who knows how long later, Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes and found himself still in the secret chamber of Tianqing Sect, as if everything just now was merely a dream. But in his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment was faintly glowing, emitting an unprecedented aura.

Chen Ji lowered his head to look at the Tianji Record Fragment in his hand, his heart filled with countless emotions. The truth of the universe pressed down on his heart like a boulder, yet also ignited a never-before-seen flame within him. He once thought he was playing chess against the Eye of Heavenly Secrets—now he knew he was merely a piece on the board. But the Guardian was right—the Tianji Record is the only loophole in this chessboard. And he, perhaps, is the only variable with a chance to break through all this.

"Free will..." Chen Ji murmured to himself, a meaningful curve appearing at the corner of his mouth. He never believed in destiny, never believed anyone could control his fate. Not the Eye of Heavenly Secrets, and not the Guardian. Since the universe is a chessboard, then he would become the one who overturns the board—or, become the new Chess Player. Outside the secret chamber, the night wind howled, as if playing the overture for an approaching storm. And Chen Ji knew—the real game had just begun.
